blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Wednesday led the groundbreaking ceremony for the Metro Manila Subway Project (MMSP) Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) Terminal 3 Station, which will reduce travel time from Valenzuela City to Pasay City from about one hour and 30 minutes to just 40 minutes. The Naia Terminal 3 Station, which will be located beneath the terminal’s open parking area, is set to commence construction in October. It is projected to accommodate around 70,000 passengers daily by 2035 and 74,000 by 2045. READ: Marcos: Metro Manila Subway project ahead of schedule In his speech, Marcos touted the […]...
